# Symptom baselines in people without cancer (NHANES check of the v3 model)

*Generated by `make nhanes`; do not edit by hand.*

Source: NHANES 2007-2012 (E,F,G), age ≥40, no self-reported cancer, WTINT2YR/3 weighted. Respondents aged 40 or more: 11763; without cancer: 10203. Self-reported lung cancer (40+): 37, too few for the cancer column, so only the baselines **without cancer** are used.

| Symptom (NHANES definition) | Smoking | NHANES % (n) | 40-54 | 55-64 | 65+ | Implied by v3 % (no cancer) |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Chronic cough (most days, 3 months or more) | never | 5.7 (5294) | 3.9 | 7.8 | 7.6 | 10.0 |
| Chronic cough (most days, 3 months or more) | former | 9.2 (2915) | 7.3 | 7.3 | 13.1 | 16.5 |
| Chronic cough (most days, 3 months or more) | current | 25.1 (1984) | 24.2 | 23.2 | 34.6 | 30.3 |
| Phlegm (most days, 3 months or more) | never | 4.4 (5295) | 2.9 | 5.1 | 6.9 | – |
| Phlegm (most days, 3 months or more) | former | 8.1 (2916) | 7.0 | 6.0 | 11.0 | – |
| Phlegm (most days, 3 months or more) | current | 18.8 (1986) | 15.9 | 23.6 | 24.5 | – |
| Wheeze or whistling (past 12 months) | never | 8.4 (5299) | 8.4 | 9.0 | 7.6 | 8.0 |
| Wheeze or whistling (past 12 months) | former | 14.4 (2911) | 16.1 | 11.7 | 14.6 | 14.1 |
| Wheeze or whistling (past 12 months) | current | 27.2 (1986) | 27.3 | 28.5 | 23.8 | 26.3 |

## Notes

- The NHANES definition of chronic cough (most days for three months or more) is narrower than the agent's question about a cough that does not go away, so the NHANES rates are expected to sit slightly below the model values. **Calibration (16 October 2026):** the wheeze baselines of the first v3 were about 1.8 times too low and `leak`, `smoke` and `copd` were updated to NHANES (never 8 %, former 14 %, current 26 %); for cough the never and former baselines were kept and the current-smoker contribution was raised toward the NHANES rate (about 30 %).
- Age: chronic cough and phlegm are clearly higher at 65 or more (35 % in current smokers). Symptoms do not depend on age in the model; an edge from age to the respiratory symptoms could be considered later.
- Only 37 respondents aged 40 or more reported lung cancer, all of them survivors; this cannot be used for the cancer column.
- NHANES asks about wheeze over the past 12 months, which is close to the agent's question about wheezing when breathing.
- Dyspnoea is not in the RDQ module of these cycles; the literature value is kept.
- The smoking effect (ratio of current to never) tests the size of the COPD-mediated mechanism in v3: if the ratio in NHANES is larger than the model's, the `smoke` or `copd` contribution should be raised.
- The association *between* symptoms (cough and wheeze, odds ratio 4.1 in never-smokers without COPD) was computed from the same data in November 2026 and calibrates the common-cause node of v3.1; see [`model_v3_1_calibration_fix.md`](model_v3_1_calibration_fix.md).
